name: OKC_MANUAL_PRICE_ADJUSTMENTS
description: This table stores price adjustments for charges

columns.name: ID
columns.description: ID

columns.name: MANUAL_ADJ_PUID
columns.description: Public Unique Identifier for the Manual Adjustments table

columns.name: MAJOR_VERSION
columns.description: Identifies the contract major version

columns.name: VERSION_TYPE
columns.description: VERSION_TYPE can have 3 values: C, A & H. Updates are allowed only if the Version_Type is ''C'

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: 'SEQUENCE IN WHICH THIS ADJUSTMENT IS APPLIED IN RELATION TO OTHER MANUAL PRICE ADJUSTMENTS

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_VALUE
columns.description: UNITIZED VALUE USED IN CALCULATING THE MANUAL/NEGOTIATED DISCOUNT FOR CHARGE OR TOTAL. CAN BE A MONETARY UNIT OR A PERCENT VALUE

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: CURRENCY OF MANUAL PRICE ADJUSTMENTS SUCH AS PRICE OVERRIDES AND AMOUNT BASED ADJUSTMENTS

columns.name: REASON_CODE
columns.description: CODE  WHICH EXPLAINS  RATIONALE FOR A MANUAL DISCOUNT

columns.name: USAGE_UOM_CODE
columns.description: USAGE UOM CODE OF THE CHARGE ON WHICH MANUAL ADJUSTMENT IS APPLIED

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: VALID_FROM
columns.description: MANUAL ADJUSTMENT''S EFFECTIVE START DATE

columns.name: VALID_UNTIL
columns.description: MANUAL ADJUSTMENT''S EFFECTIVE END DATE

columns.name: DNZ_CHR_ID
columns.description: Contract Id

columns.name: PRICE_PERIODICITY_CODE
columns.description: PRICE PERIODICITY CODE OF THE CHARGE TO WHICH THE MANUAL PRICE ADJUSTMENT IS APPLIED

columns.name: CHARGE_PARENT_ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: 'ENTITY CODE TO WHICH ADJUSTMENT IS APPLIED

columns.name: CHARGE_PARENT_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: ENTITY ID TO WHICH ADJUSTMENT IS APPLIED

columns.name: CHARGE_ROLLUP_FLAG
columns.description: CHARGE ROLLUP ON FLAG OF THE CHARGE TO WHICH THE MANUAL PRICE ADJUSTMENT IS APPLIED

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: METHOD USED FOR CALCULATING A MANUAL/NEGOTIATED DISCOUNT FOR  PRODUCT CHARGE

columns.name: BASIS_ELEMENT_CODE
columns.description: PRICING BASIS FOR CALCULATION OF ADJUSTMENT

columns.name: CHARGE_DEFINITION_CODE
columns.description: 'DEFINITION CODE OF CHARGE  TO WHICH MANUAL PRICE ADJUSTMENT IS APPLIED

columns.name: CHARGE_DEFINITION_ID
columns.description: ID OF THE CHARGE TO WHICH MANUAL PRICE ADJUSTMENT IS APPLIED

columns.name: MANUAL_PRICING_ERROR
columns.description: Indicates the pricing error message to be returned to indicate the details of the validation.

columns.name: CHARGE_ID
columns.description: ID OF THE CHARGE TO WHICH MANUAL PRICE ADJUSTMENT IS APPLIED

columns.name: PERIOD_FROM
columns.description: Billing period start for manual adjustments on billing

columns.name: PERIOD_UNTIL
columns.description: Billing period end for manual adjustments on billing

columns.name: CLE_ID
columns.description: ID OF THE LINE TO WHICH MANUAL PRICE ADJUSTMENT IS APPLIED

columns.description: EXTERNAL_KEY1
